title: TNCSE: Tensor Norm Constraints for Unsupervised Contrastive Learning of Sentence Embeddings
subcategory: unsupervised contrastive learning with norm constraints and ensembling
problem: InfoNCE with cosine similarity constrains only the direction of embeddings and ignores their norms.
architecture: Two encoders (one pre-trained with round-trip-translation augmentation, one with unsupervised SimCSE) trained jointly with InfoNCE plus a tensor-norm constraint between positive pairs on the pooler output; ensemble at inference.

datasets.name: MTEB
datasets.details: zero-shot: STS17, STS22, 30 classification, 30 retrieval and reranking tasks

key_results: BERT-base average over seven STS tasks 79.58 vs 79.04 for EDFSE and 76.25 for SimCSE.
strengths: Identifies norm information as an ignored signal in contrastive sentence learning.
Zero-shot evaluation on MTEB in addition to STS.

limitations.text: Norm constraints cannot be applied to the last hidden state because LayerNorm removes norm information; removing LayerNorms hurt training.
Uses an ensemble of two encoders, which increases inference cost compared with a single encoder.
